honest_notes: No code or content changed in this stage; DemoGame_1 has nothing new to commit. All runs are read-only on the binaries of the free-look commit f1a9c29.

The plan's F16-F20 (grip, reload hands, FP arms, free look, card-shop parity) were not folded into gun_playtest.py; the dedicated probes re-run here cover them (grip, reload, FP views, free look). Card-shop movement parity (holstered pose vs the stock SandboxCharacter_CMC 0.0 cm, gait speeds 0 %) was measured in G10a and not re-measured; the free-look probe saw the GASP speeds (run 500, sprint 700 cm/s) with the gun out.
F14 performance is reported only: the burst's frame time is 1.4-1.6 ms over idle (mean 6.5-6.6 ms, max 16-19 ms, 0 hitches).
The play-test script itself logs one Python DeprecationWarning (TraceTypeQuery.TRACE_TYPE_QUERY1 at gun_playtest.py:1522): a test-script warning, not game code.
Hip hold left as the user asked: barrel yaw 5.95 deg (G10a), and from the hip the over-the-shoulder camera sees most of the rifle behind the body; hold RMB to see it.
